steps.label: 2331-own-shared-hml-cms-apply-confirmation
command: (async()=>{if(location.pathname!=='/item/all/modify.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089242'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own latest edit only');const owner=document.querySelector('[data-editor-url]'),pending=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-webhwp-result]')].filter(e=>e.value);if(owner.dataset.itemDetailId!=='2088906'||pending.length!==2||pending.some(e=>!e.dataset.webhwpResult.startsWith('passage.')))throw Error('Only shared passage HML results required');const modal=document.getElementById('applyAllModal'),shown=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('HML apply validation did not open modal')),5000);modal.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.innerText.trim()==='전체 반영'&&e.getClientRects().length).click();await shown;return {id:modal.id,text:modal.innerText,finalConfirmClicked:false,pending:pending.map(e=>({slot:e.dataset.webhwpResult,value:e.value}))};})()
